pattern: Generated cards place the object small, centered, and seen straight-on, with an even gap of background on every side (margin_min often above the real maximum, and box width or height under the real minimum). Real cards push the hero big and close, tilt it or show it at three-quarters, and let it run near or past an edge. Generated scenes also add side props or a flat diagram layout that pulls attention from the hero.
